The whole or cut, dried leaf of Cy- nara scolymus. It contains a minimum 0.8% of chlorogenic acid (C16H18O9 = 354.3), calculated with reference to the dried drug. Protect from light. Profile Cynara, the leaf of the globe artichoke, Cynara scolymus (Com- positae), is reputed to have diuretic and choleretic properties. It may also have some hypolipidaemic activity. ◊ References. 1.
